sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 107

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 107:1
items.html: Half of Tifferet means from the Chazeh downward, because Tifferet includes ten Sefirot, VAK and GAR: the GAR up to the Chazeh are considered its half, and the seven lower [Sefirot] from the Chazeh downward, up to the conclusion of Tifferet, are likewise considered its half. (Item 2).
